profile.headline: Software Engineer II
profile.summary:
Backend software engineer at The Aspen Group, building the data infrastructure and workflow tooling that powers operations for 1,100+ dental offices nationwide. I specialize in .NET/C#, GraphQL, and event-driven systems.

My recent work focuses on backend platforms that turn cross-system data into real-time workflows for office teams: work queues, operational dashboards, and microservices. I architected the work queue infrastructure now underpinning multiple products across our platform, with features collectively tracking $9.5MM+ in recovered and retained revenue YTD. I also built the team's first event-driven microservice, migrating critical business logic out of a shared monolith to eliminate company-wide deployment risk and enable independent release cycles.

Beyond shipping features, I focus on infrastructure and enablement: establishing the data layer patterns, deployment pipelines, and architectural standards the broader engineering team builds on. I also drive AI tooling adoption, and tooling I designed has reduced time to merge by 22% and tripled the detail in merge request documentation across the team.

I love talking about DEI in tech and in the Chicago community. I want to get more Latinas into tech, I want tech to be more equitable, and I want to build tools that level the playing field.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Primary backend developer for an operational metrics platform serving 1,100+ dental offices nationwide. Design backend system architecture, establish reusable patterns for work queue infrastructure, and lead 3–5 engineers across US and European time zones through architectural decisions and implementation using .NET/C#, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL.

Led team-wide AI tooling adoption by designing reusable automations for ticket creation, QA documentation, merge request descriptions, and commit workflows, alongside an AI-queryable knowledge base that makes platform architecture and business logic searchable on demand. Time to merge dropped 22% and merge request descriptions grew 3x more detailed with no reduction in review thoroughness.

Built the team's event-driven microservice, migrating work queue logic out of a shared monolith where any deploy risked a company-wide outage — establishing isolated ownership and independent release cycles that cut queue delivery time by ~40%. The pilot captured $4.95MM in recovered revenue in its first six weeks.

Architected multiple operational work queues from scratch through nationwide rollout. Features collectively track $9.5MM+ in recovered and retained revenue YTD across the office manager dashboard.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Used C#, Java, and React with Node.js to build and maintain applications that allow users to
research housing development opportunities, underwrite deals, and manage assets once
projects are completed.
Established testing guidelines and wrote documentation that created a pattern for adding React
Testing Library tests. Additionally, coordinated with the team to increase test coverage which
resulted in a coverage increase from <1% to 58%.
Created and set the standard for documentation on unit testing, our CI/CD release process,
database access, and passing the AWS Cloud Practitioner exam.
Took on Housing support and modernization initiatives: updated reporting metrics, created
better error handling, added a color coordinating system to indicate which deals were locked
by other users, and added charts for users to see inspection approval status.
Engage in weekly CI/CD releases with Jenkins-like tools, releasing full stack changes to Prod
applications and databases.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Applications · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Application Development · Programming · Programming Languages · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Relational Databases

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Used proprietary JPMorgan Chase software to automate a 24-48 hour process by harnessing internal APIs and following JPMorgan Chase style standards. This now 2 minute process applied over 2500+ occurrences yearly saves countless hours for the clients.
Functioned as the API team lead and in storing/formatting API call information within the frontend. Coordinated between the tech API and the userbase’s needs to ensure that information was processed accurately to banking standards.

positions.title: Program Intern
positions.description:
Provide programmatic and administrative support to the IPP team in an effort to reduce mass incarceration.
Synthesize case files for hundreds of incarcerated clients and non-clients.
Assist with client legal calls, review client letters, and communicate with client’s family members to support commutation petitions
Assist staff with miscellaneous programmatic and administrative support including strategic planning, intake management, systems development, and client support.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Used HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and PHP to create a clean frontend user interface for the dynamic web app solution our team constructed.
Developed methods and format for JavaScript files to dynamically fill frontend structures with relevant information retrieved from our team’s API through post/get requests.
Discussed forms of and solutions for bias in tech with leaders in the firm, including VPs, Executive Directors, and CEO Jamie Dimon.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked as a digital intern for the company US History Scene, a multimedia history education website. Prepared the Sojourners digital humanities project for an official fall launch. Developed press release content, streamlined and uploaded new articles, uploaded the primary sources for the digital curricula. Performed general website maintenance, development, and reformatting of previous articles.
